purpose: Persistent engineering ledger so architecture, corrections, negative results, implementation decisions and validation gates survive long context windows.

entries.decision: ADV_Elite is simultaneously autonomous room brain, portable personal terminal and smart-home organ.
M2R is a physics-informed forward World Model / future-state generator; adaptive temporal resolution is subordinate.
Code 1488 activates M2R active future-simulation mode; Tachyon temporal continuity may remain passive outside it.
Predict WORLD + SWARM + SELF within observability/model boundaries; JANUS itself is part of its world model.
entries.truth_guard: No literal retrocausality/future information access; Dirac-belt language is architectural metaphor only.

entries.decision: JANUS is distributed swarm cognition; ADV_Elite is one autonomous predictive Beacon/Tachyon/M2R organ, not the sole brain.
Every device is an independent solo-capable compute/learning node; swarm connectivity is optional and increases shared data/experience; Habitat is optional heavy compute/archive.
A+B memory: continuous Witness + semantic important memory; storage-less nodes offload to capable peers; ordinary old data may be forgotten after value extraction and retention/provenance gates.
Nodes write canonical JANUS-compatible JSON event records directly; runtime storage is JSONL/NDJSON; sealed history is JSON chunk+manifest with per-node/session hash chain.
ADV_Elite selects KEEP_INTERESTING / ANOMALY / DROP and authors canonical JSON; trusted gateway authenticates/verifies and publishes to GitHub; no GitHub credential on ESP32.
Legacy HRAIN/Titan uplink becomes a single nonblocking Outbox. Canonical flow: ADV -> Outbox -> Registry Gateway -> GitHub JSON -> HRain read-only graph.

Anomaly layer is always on. Ensemble uses Z + robust-Z/MAD + prediction error + swarm disagreement + derivatives/context. Onboard LED signals anomaly; L toggles only LED output; [/] control display and LED brightness together.
entries.correction: Legacy Beacon gated anomaly evaluation behind loveExperimentActive; removed as restorative bugfix.

entries.result: 1488/common-memory/raw-telemetry+hash/HRain lineages mapped to current ADV; Keymaker/Physarum/resource contraction/Morse retained as candidates; historical efficiency M2R renamed if reused so it cannot redefine current World Model M2R.

frozen_truth_rules: future data is not available before its timestamp
peer provenance and staleness remain explicit
training loss alone is not evidence of improved future prediction
failed predictions and negative experiments are preserved
GitHub publication is not evidence of anomaly causation
LED anomaly indication is detector state, not proof of extraordinary physical cause
